description_expanded: **Recently refreshed with a full interior renovation in 2025, this home is now ready to welcome new renters again. New photos coming soon! **Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful 30A Home! * Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 miles (parking, restrooms, and seasonal lifeguards)* Luxury 3BR Home in Highland Parks* 4 Bikes Included* 6-Seater Golf Cart - Optional $75/Nt ($500 refundable deposit required)* Multiple Porches and Balcony, Outdoor Shower, and Gas Grill* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-observation Tower* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center!* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs from November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Blue Mountain RNR is a luxury 3-bedroom, 2.5 bath home in the Highland Parks community of Blue Mountain Beach, just off Hwy 30A. Only minutes from the beach access, this stunning home features a bright, open floor plan with premium hardwood flooring, high-end finishes, spacious patios, a balcony, and a chef’s kitchen with granite counters, a gas range, and a custom hood. This elegant home offers a king master bedroom that boasts a private balcony and an ensuite bath with dual sinks and a spacious walk-in shower. Additionally, there’s a queen bedroom, a bedroom with a full bed, and a queen-over-queen bunk bed. There are wall-mounted flat-screen TVs in all bedrooms and the living room. Relax outside on the shaded deck or ride the bikes down to the pool pavilion for the world-class pool, viewing tower, grilling, and entertainment! Have the vacation of a lifetime at Blue Mountain RNR!Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach, featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and is surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.The Bed Setup: 2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Full Bed + Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed*Parking is only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA. *Area Attractions: This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
